capabilities.description: Clubs can book the whole rink or half of it. The club's hourly rate is stored, and each month the club gets an invoice for the hours it booked.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Members are registered and identified by a membership number. The rink tracks each member's allowance of free entries.
capabilities.name: Membership registration and free-entry allowance

capabilities.description: Managers create the public skating sessions and list them in time order. A session's capacity shrinks when clubs book part or all of the rink.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and capacity management

capabilities.description: Ice temperature readings are recorded. If the ice stays warm too long, the next session is put on hold and skaters are told. The held session is then either cancelled with refunds or released for sale again.
capabilities.name: Ice safety monitoring and session hold

capabilities.description: Skaters buy session tickets at the right price and the places are reserved. Payment goes through the external PuckPay provider, which reports results back to the rink. Bookings left unpaid are released when their time runs out, and refunds are sent back through the payment provider.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales, online payment and refunds

capabilities.description: The rink keeps a fixed stock of hire skates for each shoe size and checks how many are free when bookings are made.
capabilities.name: Skate hire
